features: Powerful 20W Sound: Experience rich, clear audio with a 52mm driver delivering strong bass and balanced highs, ideal for music, movies, and indoor/outdoor entertainment.
Stable Bluetooth 5.1: Enjoy fast pairing and stable wireless streaming with a 10m range, ensuring smooth audio playback from phones, tablets, and laptops.
Long Battery Backup: Built-in 2000 mAh battery offers up to 8 hours playtime at 50% volume and recharges in 3-4 hours via USB-C for convenient daily use.
Multiple Playback Modes: Supports TWS pairing, AUX input, USB drive, TF card playback, and built-in mic with voice assistant for smart, versatile audio control.
RGB Light & Easy Control: Stylish RGB lighting with long-press LED customization, mode switch button, and clear charging indicators for a user-friendly experience.
